Firm rule stands: treat >~6-8% above-EMA extension as size-DOWN or wait-for-pullback; when it co-occurs with a shallow cross, SKIP. One flag -> size down; two or more stacked -> skip. Applied correctly repeatedly: SLV skipped Aug 28 (two flags), MSTR skipped Sep 1 (three flags), EWZ skipped Sep 2 (0.033% noise cross + 7.05% ext). HAL 9/4 was a legitimate size-down (two SOFT flags: 0.298% cross + 657k borderline liq, NOT extended at 5.69%) -- the boundary case, now -0.08% and worth watching.
